Method of Attack: Bypassing WordPress API server authentication via weak hashing function in webhook-GitHub interaction, sending unauthorized POST requests to API server, executing commands on API server shell to take over server and push malicious code to WordPress sites
Exploiting WordPress update mechanism single point of failure and MD5 checksum verification weakness to deploy backdoors and malware to millions of WordPress sites
Attack Vector: GitHub webhook to WordPress API server interaction with weak authentication
POST requests with unescaped GitHub project URL parameter to API server shell
